index: Domaine du Geisberg – Holiday gîtes in Varsberg, Moselle

home.lead: Two exceptional gîtes right next to the forest, on the hill above Varsberg, at the place called Vogelsgesang, “birdsong”.
home.intro_h: A place that lives up to its name
intro: Our two gîtes are two apartments on the garden level of our house, in the heart of a vast two-hectare estate of green meadows at the edge of the forest, in an exceptional spot known as “Vogelsgesang”, birdsong.
Typical of the Lorraine countryside, the surroundings are lush and offer a beautiful panorama in a setting of calm and serenity.
home.gites_h: Two twin gîtes, the same view
home.gites_lead: The same comforts on both sides. Book one, or both for a large family.
home.around_h: On foot from the garden, or an hour’s drive
home.around_lead: Hiking trails without crossing a road, a lake and water-sports centre 6 km away, and Metz, the Saar and Luxembourg within a day trip.
home.hosts: Since 2007, the year our gîtes opened, we have enjoyed sharing our way of life with guests of all nationalities and discovering theirs. It is a way for us to get to know other countries and cultures, and to show others the riches of our region and our country. Using German and English regularly is a pleasant change of scenery.

p: Set in the heart of a vast two-hectare estate of green meadows at the edge of the forest, our two gîtes occupy the ground floor of a spacious house in an exceptional spot known as “Vogelsgesang” (birdsong).
Typical of the Lorraine countryside, the surroundings are lush and offer a beautiful panorama in a setting of calm and serenity.
There are many hiking trails, reachable without crossing a road, on foot, by bike or on horseback. Horses are available for experienced riders.

gites.lead: Two similar holiday apartments at garden level of the owners' house, each with a separate entrance, private terrace and parking.
gites.common: Each gîte has a living room with fitted kitchen (oven, ceramic hob, microwave, dishwasher, washing machine, freezer), two bedrooms and a shower room with WC, adapted for guests with reduced mobility. Sleeping: four 90 cm beds that can be pushed together in the bedrooms: 4 guests per gîte. Flat-screen TV, wifi, geothermal underfloor heating.
gites.dispo_p: Both calendars are updated in real time by our booking system, platforms included: green nights are free, red nights are taken. To book, go to the Booking page.
gites.identical: The two gîtes are twins: same rooms, same equipment, same view over the meadow. Simply choose whichever is free on your dates — or both for a larger group.

autour.lead: Hiking trails start right from the gîte, with no road to cross, on foot, by bike or on horseback. Several remarkable sites are just a few kilometres away.

creutzwald-lac: Sailing, swimming, fishing and walks around the lake.
cimetiere-americain: The largest American military cemetery in Europe.
musee-mine: The pithead and the life of Lorraine’s miners.
volklingen: A UNESCO World Heritage site just across the border.
bliesbruck: A Gallo-Roman town and its baths.
pompidou-metz: Modern and contemporary art, with Metz cathedral close by.
sainte-croix: Wolves, bears, deer and bison in the Lorraine Regional Nature Park.
boucle-sarre: The spectacular bend of the Saar, seen from the Cloef viewpoint.

reservation.included: Included: bed and household linen, beds made on arrival, end-of-stay cleaning, electricity and heating, wifi, pets. Deposit €300. Tourist tax extra. Credit cards and French ANCV holiday vouchers accepted.
reservation.form_p: Pick your dates and the gîte, leave your details: we confirm within 24 hours. For a simple question, an e-mail or a call is enough.
reservation.access_h: Getting to the Domaine du Geisberg
access: Varsberg lies between Saint-Avold and Creutzwald, 40 minutes from Metz and 30 minutes from Saarbrücken.
By car: A4 motorway (Paris–Strasbourg), exit Saint-Avold / Carling, then follow Creutzwald and Varsberg.
By train: Saint-Avold station 15 km away (Metz–Forbach regional line).
